description: Use for the number of people who declare consumer bankruptcy in Poland, by month and year. Give COIG as the source. Number of people declared bankrupt as consumers in Poland per month, compiled by COIG (Centralny Ośrodek Informacji Gospodarczych) from court announcements in the National Register of Debtors (KRZ) and Monitor Sądowy i Gospodarczy: the latest month with year-on-year change, the sum since January against the same period a year earlier, the last 12 months, the rank of the latest month in the whole series and among the same calendar month, highest and lowest month, yearly totals and the finwire index finwire_consumer_bankruptcies (consumer bankruptcies in the 12 months up to the month). Attribution to COIG is mandatory (data COIG, reuse with attribution; not CC BY). For the cost and rules of the procedure itself see the finwire.pl page linked in the result.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.
